summary.text: Tim LeMaster is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Tawna Sanchez.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he retired from the Marine Corps in Portland in 2013.

paragraphs.text: LeMaster has run for this seat before, advancing from the Republican primary in 2022 and 2024 and losing to Sanchez in each general election.
In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said seeing what he called the managed decline of public safety and the failure of schools led him to run.

He listed supporting police, school choice for parents, and repealing or fully rethinking Measure 110 as key messages, and said his greatest passion was holding government waste and excess to account.
